Legends

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/legend.Rmd
legend.Rmd

Legend Names 

library(plotly.core)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr)

data <- spread(Orange, Tree, circumference)
data <- rename(data, c("1" = "Tree1", "2" = "Tree2", "3" = "Tree3", "4" = "Tree4", "5" = "Tree5"))

data |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree1, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 1") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree2, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 2") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree3, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 3") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree4, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 4") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree5, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 5")

Hiding the Legend 

library(plotly.core)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr)

data <- spread(Orange, Tree, circumference)
data <- rename(data, c("1" = "Tree1", "2" = "Tree2", "3" = "Tree3", "4" = "Tree4", "5" = "Tree5"))

data |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree1, mode = "lines") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree2, mode = "lines") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree3, mode = "lines") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree4, mode = "lines") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree5, mode = "lines") |>
  update_layout(showlegend = FALSE)

library(plotly.core)

data <- spread(Orange, Tree, circumference)

data |>

Positioning the Legend Inside the Plot 

library(plotly.core)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr)

data <- spread(Orange, Tree, circumference)
data <- rename(data, c("1" = "Tree1", "2" = "Tree2", "3" = "Tree3", "4" = "Tree4", "5" = "Tree5"))

data |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree1, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 1") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree2, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 2") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree3, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 3") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree4, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 4") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree5, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 5") |>
  update_layout(legend = go_legend(x = 0.1, y = 0.9))

Styling the Legend 

library(plotly.core)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr)

data <- spread(Orange, Tree, circumference)
data <- rename(data, c("1" = "Tree1", "2" = "Tree2", "3" = "Tree3", "4" = "Tree4", "5" = "Tree5"))

l <- go_legend(
  font = go_font(
    family = "sans-serif",
    size = 12,
    color = "#000"
  ),
  bgcolor = "#E2E2E2",
  bordercolor = "#FFFFFF",
  borderwidth = 2
)

data |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree1, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 1") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree2, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 2") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree3, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 3") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree4, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 4") |>
  add_scatter(x = ~age, y = ~Tree5, mode = "lines", name = "Tree 5") |>
  update_layout(legend = l)

Size of Legend Items

In this example, since the itemsizing attribute of go_legend() is set to constant, the size of legend items symbols remains the same, regardless of how tiny/huge the bubbles are in the graph.

library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
    y = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scatter_marker(size = 10)
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
    y = c(5, 4, 3, 2, 1),
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scatter_marker(size = 100)
  ) |>
  update_layout(legend = go_legend(itemsizing = "constant"))

Legend Title 

library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    mode = "lines",
    x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
    y = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
    name = "Increasing"
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    mode = "lines",
    x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
    y = c(5, 4, 3, 2, 1),
    name = "Decreasing"
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    legend = go_legend(title = go_legend_title(text = "<b> Trend </b>"))
  )

Grouped Legend

Plotly legends are interactive. Click on the legend entries to hide and show traces. The legendgroup key groups legend entries so that clicking on one legend entry will hide or show all of the traces in that group.

library(plotly.core)
library(tidyr)
library(plyr)

data <- spread(Orange, Tree, circumference)
data <- rename(data, c("1" = "Tree1", "2" = "Tree2", "3" = "Tree3", "4" = "Tree4", "5" = "Tree5"))

data |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~age,
    y = ~Tree1,
    mode = "lines",
    legendgroup = "group1",
    name = "Zone 1 - Tree 1"
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~age,
    y = ~Tree2,
    mode = "lines",
    legendgroup = "group2",
    name = "Zone 2 - Tree 1"
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~age,
    y = ~Tree3,
    mode = "lines",
    legendgroup = "group1",
    name = "Zone 1 - Tree 2"
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~age,
    y = ~Tree4,
    mode = "lines",
    legendgroup = "group2",
    name = "Zone 2 - Tree 2"
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~age,
    y = ~Tree5,
    mode = "lines",
    legendgroup = "group1",
    name = "Zone 1 - Tree 3"
  )

Subplot Grouped Legend 

library(plotly.core)

df <- data.frame(x = c("a", "b", "c"), y = c(2, 3, 2), y2 = c(4, 2, 4))

make_subplots(rows = 2, cols = 1, shared_xaxes = TRUE) |>
  update_layout(colorway = c("#66C2A5", "#FC8D62", "#8DA0CB")) |>
  add_bar(
    data = df,
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    legendgroup = ~x,
    marker = go_bar_marker(color = ~x),
    row = 1,
    col = 1
  ) |>
  add_bar(
    data = df,
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y2,
    legendgroup = ~x,
    showlegend = FALSE,
    marker = go_bar_marker(color = ~x),
    row = 2,
    col = 1
  ) |>
  update_xaxes(showgrid = FALSE) |>
  update_yaxes(showgrid = FALSE)

See go_legend() for more information and chart attribute options!
